requirements.text: Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline; Ph.D. a plus.
Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline; Ph.D. a plus.
Minimum of 2 years’ experience applying advanced analytics methods (e.g., decision trees, logistic regression, neural networks, random forests).
Proficiency in R or Python for analytics and model development, including work with both structured and unstructured data.
Proven ability to manage and integrate large, complex datasets and an understanding of end-to-end data modeling processes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to connect technical outputs to business strategy.
Internship or project experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or related roles—especially in insurance or financial services.
Familiarity with actuarial concepts or insurance-specific data models.
Enthusiastic about continued learning in AI/ML and staying current with new tools and methodologies.
Comfortable in a collaborative, fast-paced, and agile working environment.
